summary: Source-reviewed owner-layer rework recovered primary CATH-2 MIC and hemolysis rows, reconciled DBAASP/APD6 database rows, and bounded mechanism claims to CD, MD simulation, and docking evidence from local materials.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed owner-layer rework recovered primary CATH-2 MIC and hemolysis rows, reconciled DBAASP/APD6 database rows, and bounded mechanism claims to CD, MD simulation, and docking evidence from local materials.

source_review_depth.paper_xml: Opened XML-derived article metadata, Table 3, CATH-2 sequence section, antimicrobial/hemolysis results, mechanism sections, and assay methods.
source_review_depth.paper_pdf: Opened extracted article PDF text as a cross-check for the same result/method surfaces.
source_review_depth.oa_package: Opened packet manifest/archive manifest and OA-package-derived XML/PDF/supplementary member inventory.
source_review_depth.supplementary_assets: Opened supplementary index and parsed XLSX tables; supplements support AMP annotation/sequence context but do not add additional MIC/toxicity endpoints beyond the primary article rows.
source_review_depth.merged_database_rows: Opened packet linked APD6/DBAASP JSONL rows plus merged APD6/DBAASP sequence and activity CSV rows for AP03617 and DBAASPR_21503.

materials_exhausted.note: Local materials were sufficient for worker-2/4/6 owner-layer repair; no unrecoverable material gap remains for the originally failing gates.

source_conflicts_preserved: APD6:AP03617 hemolysis 2% text conflicts with primary/DBAASP 22%

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows match primary MIC and hemolysis values and strain/target labels. APD6 AP03617 supports the sequence and converted MIC values, but its hemolysis percentage conflicts with primary text and is retained as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Recovered three MIC rows and one hemolysis row with raw value, unit, target species/strain, assay conditions, source locators, and linked database provenance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is bounded: CD spectroscopy is direct structural evidence, while membrane/TLR4 claims are computational modeling/docking context only.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: The original ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed because the missing activity rows, database conflict adjudication, and worker-6 source-reviewed adjudication were repaired from local materials.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP03617 entry text reports 2% hemolysis, while primary XML and DBAASP report 22% hemolysis at 62.89 µM; final activity uses the primary/DBAASP value and preserves APD6 as source_conflict.

Primary article reports MIC in µM; APD6 reports 75/90/100 µg/ml, which matches conversion using the paper/database molecular weight. Final rows keep µM as raw primary values and store µg/ml as alternate values.
MD simulation and TLR4-MD2 docking are retained as computational mechanism context, not direct wet-lab mechanism evidence.
